keyPoints.en: Lavoisier (1789): grouped substances into metals and non-metals.
keyPoints.bm: Lavoisier (1789): mengelaskan bahan kepada logam dan bukan logam.

keyPoints.en: Döbereiner (1829): triads — the middle element's mass is about the average of the other two (Li, Na, K).
keyPoints.bm: Döbereiner (1829): triad — jisim unsur tengah hampir purata dua yang lain (Li, Na, K).

keyPoints.en: Newlands (1864): law of octaves — every 8th element had similar properties.
keyPoints.bm: Newlands (1864): hukum oktaf — setiap unsur ke-8 mempunyai sifat serupa.

keyPoints.en: Mendeleev (1869): arranged by atomic mass, left gaps and predicted undiscovered elements (e.g. germanium).
keyPoints.bm: Mendeleev (1869): menyusun mengikut jisim atom, meninggalkan ruang dan meramal unsur belum ditemui (cth. germanium).

keyPoints.en: Moseley (1913): arranged by proton number — the basis of the modern table.
keyPoints.bm: Moseley (1913): menyusun mengikut nombor proton — asas jadual moden.

question.en: Why was Mendeleev's table more successful than Newlands'?
question.bm: Mengapa jadual Mendeleev lebih berjaya daripada Newlands?

answer.en: He left gaps for undiscovered elements and his predictions of their properties were later proven correct.
answer.bm: Beliau meninggalkan ruang untuk unsur belum ditemui dan ramalan sifatnya kemudian terbukti betul.

tip.en: Know one contribution per scientist — it's a common 1-mark question.
tip.bm: Ketahui satu sumbangan setiap saintis — soalan 1 markah yang biasa.

keyPoints.en: Modern Periodic Table: elements in order of increasing proton number.
keyPoints.bm: Jadual Berkala moden: unsur disusun mengikut pertambahan nombor proton.

keyPoints.en: 18 groups (vertical) and 7 periods (horizontal).
keyPoints.bm: 18 kumpulan (menegak) dan 7 kala (mengufuk).

keyPoints.en: Group number = valence electrons (Groups 1–2) or valence electrons + 10 (Groups 13–18).
keyPoints.bm: Nombor kumpulan = elektron valens (Kumpulan 1–2) atau elektron valens + 10 (Kumpulan 13–18).

keyPoints.en: Period number = number of occupied shells.
keyPoints.bm: Nombor kala = bilangan petala berisi elektron.

keyPoints.en: Metals on the left, non-metals on the right, metalloids (Si, Ge) along the zig-zag line.
keyPoints.bm: Logam di kiri, bukan logam di kanan, separuh logam (Si, Ge) di sepanjang garis zig-zag.

question.en: Element Y has electron arrangement 2.8.8.2. Give its group and period.
question.bm: Unsur Y mempunyai susunan elektron 2.8.8.2. Nyatakan kumpulan dan kalanya.

tip.en: Elements in the same group react similarly because they have the same number of valence electrons.
tip.bm: Unsur dalam kumpulan yang sama bertindak balas serupa kerana bilangan elektron valens sama.

keyPoints.en: Group 18 (noble gases): He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn — monatomic, colourless gases.
keyPoints.bm: Kumpulan 18 (gas adi): He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn — gas monoatom tidak berwarna.

keyPoints.en: Chemically inert: stable duplet (He) or octet electron arrangement — no need to gain, lose or share electrons.
keyPoints.bm: Lengai secara kimia: susunan elektron duplet (He) atau oktet yang stabil — tidak perlu menerima, melepas atau berkongsi elektron.

keyPoints.en: Going down: atomic size, melting and boiling points and density increase.
keyPoints.bm: Menuruni kumpulan: saiz atom, takat lebur, takat didih dan ketumpatan bertambah.

keyPoints.en: Uses: He (balloons, airships), Ne (advertising lights), Ar (light bulbs, welding), Kr (lasers), Xe (camera flash).
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan: He (belon, kapal udara), Ne (lampu iklan), Ar (mentol, kimpalan), Kr (laser), Xe (lampu kilat kamera).

question.en: Why is helium used instead of hydrogen in airships?
question.bm: Mengapa helium digunakan dan bukan hidrogen dalam kapal udara?

answer.en: Helium is light AND inert, so it won't burn; hydrogen is flammable.
answer.bm: Helium ringan DAN lengai, jadi tidak terbakar; hidrogen mudah terbakar.

tip.en: Don't say noble gases have 8 valence electrons — helium has only 2.
tip.bm: Jangan kata gas adi ada 8 elektron valens — helium hanya ada 2.

keyPoints.en: Group 1 (alkali metals): Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr — soft, low density, shiny when freshly cut.
keyPoints.bm: Kumpulan 1 (logam alkali): Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr — lembut, ketumpatan rendah, berkilat apabila baru dipotong.

keyPoints.en: All have 1 valence electron and form +1 ions.
keyPoints.bm: Semuanya mempunyai 1 elektron valens dan membentuk ion +1.

keyPoints.en: Reactions: with water → alkali + H₂; with oxygen → metal oxide; with chlorine → metal chloride.
keyPoints.bm: Tindak balas: dengan air → alkali + H₂; dengan oksigen → oksida logam; dengan klorin → klorida logam.

keyPoints.en: Reactivity increases down the group: larger atom, outer electron further from nucleus, lost more easily.
keyPoints.bm: Kereaktifan bertambah menuruni kumpulan: atom lebih besar, elektron luar lebih jauh dari nukleus, lebih mudah dilepaskan.

keyPoints.en: Stored in paraffin oil to prevent reaction with air and moisture.
keyPoints.bm: Disimpan dalam minyak parafin untuk mengelak tindak balas dengan udara dan lembapan.

question.en: Write the equation for potassium reacting with water.
question.bm: Tulis persamaan bagi kalium bertindak balas dengan air.

tip.en: Melting point DECREASES down Group 1 (weaker metallic bonding), while reactivity INCREASES.
tip.bm: Takat lebur BERKURANG menuruni Kumpulan 1 (ikatan logam lemah), manakala kereaktifan BERTAMBAH.

keyPoints.en: Group 17 (halogens): F₂, Cl₂, Br₂, I₂, At₂ — diatomic non-metals.
keyPoints.bm: Kumpulan 17 (halogen): F₂, Cl₂, Br₂, I₂, At₂ — bukan logam dwiatom.

keyPoints.en: States/colours: F₂ pale yellow gas, Cl₂ greenish-yellow gas, Br₂ reddish-brown liquid, I₂ purplish-black solid.
keyPoints.bm: Keadaan/warna: F₂ gas kuning pucat, Cl₂ gas kuning kehijauan, Br₂ cecair perang kemerahan, I₂ pepejal hitam keunguan.

keyPoints.en: 7 valence electrons; gain 1 electron to form −1 ions.
keyPoints.bm: 7 elektron valens; menerima 1 elektron membentuk ion −1.

keyPoints.en: Reactions: with water → two acids (Cl₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCl + HOCl); with hot iron → iron(III) halide; with NaOH → salt + water.
keyPoints.bm: Tindak balas: dengan air → dua asid (Cl₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCl + HOCl); dengan besi panas → besi(III) halida; dengan NaOH → garam + air.

keyPoints.en: Reactivity decreases down the group: bigger atoms attract an extra electron less strongly.
keyPoints.bm: Kereaktifan berkurang menuruni kumpulan: atom lebih besar kurang kuat menarik elektron tambahan.

question.en: Why does chlorine water bleach blue litmus paper?
question.bm: Mengapa air klorin melunturkan kertas litmus biru?

answer.en: It is acidic (turns litmus red), then HOCl bleaches it white.
answer.bm: Ia berasid (litmus menjadi merah), kemudian HOCl melunturkannya menjadi putih.

tip.en: Halogen experiments must be done in a fume chamber — the gases are toxic.
tip.bm: Eksperimen halogen mesti dijalankan dalam kebuk wasap — gasnya toksik.

keyPoints.en: Period 3: Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl, Ar.
keyPoints.bm: Kala 3: Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl, Ar.

keyPoints.en: Across the period: proton number increases, atomic radius decreases, electronegativity increases.
keyPoints.bm: Merentasi kala: nombor proton bertambah, jejari atom berkurang, keelektronegatifan bertambah.

keyPoints.en: Metallic → metalloid (Si) → non-metallic properties.
keyPoints.bm: Sifat logam → separuh logam (Si) → bukan logam.

keyPoints.en: Oxides change from basic (Na₂O, MgO) → amphoteric (Al₂O₃) → acidic (SiO₂, P₄O₁₀, SO₂, Cl₂O₇).
keyPoints.bm: Oksida berubah dari bes (Na₂O, MgO) → amfoterik (Al₂O₃) → asid (SiO₂, P₄O₁₀, SO₂, Cl₂O₇).

keyPoints.en: Silicon is a semiconductor — used to make microchips.
keyPoints.bm: Silikon ialah semikonduktor — digunakan untuk membuat cip mikro.

question.en: Explain why atomic radius decreases from Na to Cl.
question.bm: Terangkan mengapa jejari atom berkurang dari Na ke Cl.

answer.en: Proton number increases while the number of shells stays at 3, so the nucleus pulls electrons closer.
answer.bm: Nombor proton bertambah sedangkan bilangan petala kekal 3, jadi nukleus menarik elektron lebih dekat.

tip.en: Amphoteric = reacts with BOTH acid and alkali (Al₂O₃, ZnO).
tip.bm: Amfoterik = bertindak balas dengan asid DAN alkali (Al₂O₃, ZnO).

keyPoints.en: Transition elements: Groups 3–12, e.g. Fe, Cu, Zn, Ni, Mn, Cr. All are metals.
keyPoints.bm: Unsur peralihan: Kumpulan 3–12, cth. Fe, Cu, Zn, Ni, Mn, Cr. Semuanya logam.

keyPoints.en: Hard, shiny, high melting points and density, good conductors.
keyPoints.bm: Keras, berkilat, takat lebur dan ketumpatan tinggi, konduktor yang baik.

keyPoints.en: Special properties: coloured compounds, catalysts, several oxidation numbers (Fe²⁺, Fe³⁺), form complex ions.
keyPoints.bm: Sifat istimewa: sebatian berwarna, mangkin, beberapa nombor pengoksidaan (Fe²⁺, Fe³⁺), membentuk ion kompleks.

keyPoints.en: Catalyst examples: iron (Haber process), vanadium(V) oxide (Contact process), nickel (making margarine).
keyPoints.bm: Contoh mangkin: besi (proses Haber), vanadium(V) oksida (proses Sentuh), nikel (membuat marjerin).

question.en: Give the colour of Cu²⁺, Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ solutions.
question.bm: Nyatakan warna larutan Cu²⁺, Fe²⁺ dan Fe³⁺.

answer.en: Cu²⁺ blue, Fe²⁺ pale green, Fe³⁺ yellowish-brown.
answer.bm: Cu²⁺ biru, Fe²⁺ hijau pucat, Fe³⁺ perang kekuningan.

tip.en: Coloured gemstones (rubies, emeralds) get their colours from transition metal ions.
tip.bm: Batu permata berwarna (delima, zamrud) mendapat warna daripada ion logam peralihan.
